description: This PHP source file generates a web page for adding port triggering rules in a network configuration interface. It includes HTML and JavaScript for form validation and AJAX submission, along with server-side includes for headers and navigation.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Handles the form submission via AJAX to add a new port triggering rule. Sends data to the server-side script and handles response for success or failure.

methods.name: document.ready
methods.description: Initializes the form validation, sets up event handlers for buttons, and configures validation rules and messages.
